authority_invariants.note: This milestone is infrastructure/semantic capability only. No authority is promoted by its existence.

public_api.query_as_of: Deterministic knowledge-cutoff query returning AsofQueryResult with one of: READY, UNKNOWN_TEMPORAL, NOT_YET_KNOWABLE, NO_QUALIFYING_OBSERVATION, CONFLICT
public_api.build_revision_ledger: Full ordered revision ledger with per-entry knowability flags at a given cutoff
public_api.deterministic_ledger_hash: Stable SHA-256 of canonical serialised ledger
public_api.canonical_result_identity: Stable identity string for a complete as-of query result

result_codes.READY: Exactly one qualifying observation is knowable as of the cutoff
result_codes.UNKNOWN_TEMPORAL: Temporal evidence present but insufficient; fail closed
result_codes.NOT_YET_KNOWABLE: Observation exists but knowledge boundary is after the cutoff
result_codes.NO_QUALIFYING_OBSERVATION: No observation present in the supplied evidence set
result_codes.CONFLICT: Multiple knowable candidates, deterministic resolution not permitted

pit_safety_invariants: Never selects an observation whose knowledge_available_research_session is after as_of_research_session
HTTP Date/Last-Modified/ETag are never used for knowledge determination
query_as_of does not backfill or infer from current file/db state
ordering is deterministic: by knowledge_session asc, then observation_identity as tiebreaker
